name: MIST
source:
MIST is a survival mystery game, set in a world hit by a sudden catastrophe. You want nothing more than to relax at your late grandfather's old mountain hut, when you are suddenly surrounded by a thick unnatural fog. To make it worse, dangerous shadowy monsters lurk in the woods and attack you. But there is a glimmer of hope. A girl that was able to flee and now lives with you. The tension is high and survival difficult, but you have to pull through. Survive, unravel the mystery and forge bonds with the girls you meet in this desperate situation.

[From [url=https://395games.itch.io/mist]itch.io[/url] and [url=https://www.patreon.com/395games]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
MIST是一款生存悬疑游戏，背景设定在一个遭受突如其来的灾难的世界中。当你突然被浓浓的不自然的雾气包围时，你只想在已故祖父的老山小屋里放松一下。更糟糕的是，危险的阴影怪物潜伏在树林里并攻击你。但还有一线希望。一个能够逃脱并现在和你住在一起的女孩。压力很大，生存很困难，但你必须渡过难关。生存下来，解开谜团，并与你在这种绝望的情况下遇到的女孩建立联系。

[来自[url=https://395games.itch.io/mist]itch.io[/url] 和 [url=https://www.patreon.com/395games]Patreon[/url]]
